title: Billion Dollar Buy, $70K Floor
script_summary:
**BILLION DOLLAR BID FLOOR**

Bitcoin's at $70,009 and a billion dollars just vanished from the open market in a single session. MicroStrategy deployed over a billion in one trading day—14,000 Bitcoin pulled from liquid circulation. That's not portfolio management. That's supply collapse at institutional scale.

Here's what nobody's pricing: Saylor now has a structural mandate to buy ANY price below his rising cost basis. That creates an asymmetric bid floor that didn't exist in previous cycles.
